label: Dark Metamorphosis stat buff
summary: While Dark Metamorphosis is active Alucard gets +25 ATK (non-zero attack values, capped at 999), +25 INT (shown and effective) and +25 DEF (capped at 999).

edits.why: Code cave in DebugCaptureVideo (0x800E2824, never called in US): entry stub `jr ra; nop` + attackBonus @0x800E282C, statsBonus @0x800E2864, refreshBonus @0x800E28E0 (ends 0x800E290B)
CalcAttack shared epilogue `jr $ra` -> `j 0x800E282C` (attackBonus); delay-slot nop kept
`jal func_801092E8` -> `jal 0x800E28E0` (refreshBonus; Dark Metamorphosis start, right after timer store)

vanilla.reason: All hook words and the cave are identical in vanilla and ASS 1.3.1; the cave is the unused DebugCaptureVideo body and the code only calls vanilla functions (CalcDefense 0x800F4FD0, func_801092E8, make_all 0x800F53A4) and reads vanilla RAM (timer 0x80072F16, g_Status 0x80097BD0/0x80097BE0/0x80097C24).

tunables.why: ATK bonus: int16 LE immediate of `addiu $v0,$v0,25` (attackBonus, applied to every non-zero CalcAttack result)
INT bonus (displayed): int16 LE immediate of `addiu $t2,$t2,25` added to g_Status.statsEquip[INT] 0x80097BD0
INT bonus (effective): int16 LE immediate of `addiu $t2,$t2,25` added to g_Status.statsTotal[INT] 0x80097BE0 (keep equal to 0x42894)
DEF bonus: int16 LE immediate of `addiu $t2,$t2,25` added to g_Status.defenseEquip 0x80097C24

display.detail: All values are signed 16-bit little-endian immediates in DRA.BIN (low halfword of the instruction word).

values.label: INT
values.instruction: 0x254A0019 addiu $t2,$t2,imm @0x800E2894 (statsEquip INT; 0x428A4 statsTotal INT holds the same value)

overlaps.detail: Independent. Both use the DebugCaptureVideo cave but byte-disjoint (16: 0x42824-0x4290B, 17: 0x42910-0x4292F); no shared hook sites (16 hooks CalcAttack/make_all/func_801092E8 calls, 17 hooks seven SetSpeedX calls); neither calls the other. Both just read timer 0x80072F16. The 16 entry stub `jr ra; nop` is not needed by 17 because DebugCaptureVideo has no callers in US. All four on/off combinations are valid.

overlaps.hack: mp-cost-items / quick-items (Faerie buff + Meal Ticket cave code)
overlaps.detail: Same cave, byte-disjoint: Faerie stat-buff code at 0x4290C (dead leftover word) and 0x42930-0x42A7F (entered from SERVANT/TT_002 at 0x800E2934/29E4/2A08/2A1C), Meal-Ticket-Throw code at 0x42A80-0x42AFC; Food/Meal-Ticket L2 code fills the preceding function 0x424A0-0x42820. None of it references 0x800E2824-0x800E290B, so turning 16 off/on does not affect them.
An unattributed edit inside CalcAttack at 0x54D70-0x54D83 (equip-category test rewritten) is in the same function as the 0x54F40 epilogue hook but byte-disjoint; no interaction.
Reawakened itself also puts code at 0x42824 and hooks func_801092E8 calls 0x693A4/0x6AB34; those Reawakened parts are NOT in ASS 2.0, so no conflict now, but they would collide if ever ported.

notes: Source: Dark-Metamorphosis-Plus25-Alternate-Scarlet-Symphony-2.0.ppf + manifest + work/implementation-plan.md (Codex 2026-09-26/check-sotn-decomp-github-and-base-2). All PPF bytes verified in a (and t, b); off = o = v for every byte (the cave region 0x42824-0x42B00 is unchanged vanilla in ASS 1.3.1). Cave check: DebugCaptureVideo = 0x800E2824-0x800E2AFF (vanilla epilogue jr ra at 0x42AF8); decomp DebugUpdate calls it only for VERSION_HD/PC. A scan of every code file (DRA, RIC, SLUS, SERVANT/*, WEAPON*, MONSTER, all ST/BOSS overlays) in v, o, t, b and a found no jal/j or 32-bit pointer (and no lui/addiu-style pair: all code files in v and a, DRA in o/t/b) to 0x800E2824 and no reference into 0x800E282C-0x800E290B other than this hack's own hooks. Off restores the vanilla DebugCaptureVideo prologue/body bytes, which is safe because it is never called. Behaviour: attackBonus adds 25 only when v0 != 0 and the timer (lh 0x80072F16) > 0; statsBonus runs CalcDefense then adds the bonuses; refreshBonus runs func_801092E8 (a0 preserved) then make_all so stats refresh when the spell starts/ends.
